-----------------------------------------------------------------------

<div style = "background-color: #FEFEFE; padding-top: 35px; padding-left: 60px; padding-right: 60px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 2; margin: 0 auto; max-width: 900px;">

<img style='padding-right:20px; padding-bottom:12px;' align="left" width="70" src="assets/Royalty-free from needpix.com.png">

This open-source, R-based web application allows the conversion of video captions (subtitles) from the [Web Video Text Tracks (WebVTT) Format](https://www.w3.org/TR/webvtt1/) into plain texts. For this purpose, users upload a WebVTT file with the extension `.vtt` or `.txt` (examples available [here](https://github.com/pablobernabeu/VTT-Transcription-App/blob/main/assets/Example_subtitles_1.vtt) and [here](https://github.com/pablobernabeu/VTT-Transcription-App/blob/main/assets/Example_subtitles_2.txt)). Automatically, metadata such as timestamps are removed, and the text is formatted into a paragraph. The result is displayed below, and can be downloaded as `.docx` and `.txt` documents. Overall, this application serves to improve the accessibility of video captions.

The data is only available to the user, and is deleted when the website is closed.


<h3>Upload WebVTT file with `.vtt` or `.txt` extension</h3>

```{r}

fileInput("upload", NULL, buttonLabel = "Upload", multiple = FALSE, 
          accept = c(".vtt", ".txt"), width = '500px')

# Convert the lines of a caption file into a single paragraph of plain text.
# The parsing follows the WebVTT specification (https://www.w3.org/TR/webvtt1/)
# and also accepts SubRip files, which use a comma before the milliseconds.
# Everything except the text of the captions is removed, and that text is
# otherwise kept as it is.

clean_captions = function(lines) {

  # Remove any byte order mark, and trailing spaces or carriage returns
  lines = str_remove(lines, '^\ufeff')
  lines = str_remove(lines, '\\s+$')
  if(length(lines) == 0) return('')

  # A file consists of blocks of lines separated by blank lines
  blank = lines == ''
  block_start = !blank & c(TRUE, head(blank, -1))
  block = cumsum(block_start)

  # Cue timing lines, such as '00:00:01.000 --> 00:00:04.000' or
  # '00:01.000 --> 00:04.000 align:start'. Hours are optional, and the
  # second timestamp may be followed by cue settings.
  timestamp = '(\\d+:)?\\d{2}:\\d{2}[.,]\\d+'
  timing = str_detect(lines, str_c('^\\s*', timestamp, '\\s*-->\\s*',
                                   timestamp, '(\\s.*)?$'))

  # An identifier is an optional line that opens a cue, just above the
  # timing line (e.g., '1' or '6fbb1fca-421a-4ee9-942b-cee0dc425f8a')
  identifier = block_start & c(timing[-1], FALSE)

  # Blocks that are not captions: the header of the file (e.g., 'WEBVTT'
  # followed by 'Kind: captions'), comments ('NOTE') and style or region
  # definitions. If a timing line follows without a blank line in between,
  # the caption starts there.
  block_type = lines[block_start]
  non_caption = str_detect(block_type, '^NOTE(\\s|$)|^(STYLE|REGION)$')
  non_caption[1] = non_caption[1] || str_detect(block_type[1], '^WEBVTT(\\s|$)')
  before_timing = ave(timing, block, FUN = cumsum) == 0
  metadata = block %in% which(non_caption) & before_timing

  text = lines[!blank & !timing & !identifier & !metadata]

  # Remove inline tags, such as voice tags ('<v Name>' and '</v>'), classes
  # ('<c.yellow>'), italics ('<i>') and karaoke timestamps ('<00:00:01.500>')
  text = str_remove_all(text, regex(str_c('</?(v|c|i|b|u|lang|ruby|rt|font)([.\\s][^>]*)?>|',
                                          '<(\\d+:)?\\d{2}:\\d{2}\\.\\d+>'),
                                    ignore_case = TRUE))

  # Decode the character references used in captions, leaving '&amp;'
  # until last so that text such as '&amp;lt;' becomes '&lt;'
  text = str_replace_all(text, c('&lt;' = '<', '&gt;' = '>', '&nbsp;' = '\u00a0',
                                 '&lrm;' = '\u200e', '&rlm;' = '\u200f',
                                 '&quot;' = '"', '&apos;' = "'", '&amp;' = '&'))

  # Join the lines into a paragraph
  text = str_trim(text)
  str_c(text[text != ''], collapse = ' ')
}

# Process the uploaded file
transcript = reactive({
  req(input$upload)
  clean_captions(readLines(input$upload$datapath, warn = FALSE, encoding = 'UTF-8'))
})

```



<h2>Transcript</h2>


```{r}

# Enter preferred name

renderUI({
  if(isTruthy(input$upload)) {
    textInput('downloaded_file_name', 
              'Editable name of the file to be downloaded',
              # Edit file name to remove extension
              value = paste('transcript --', 
                            str_replace(input$upload$name, '\\.vtt$|\\.txt$', '')),
              width = '500px'
    )
  } else print('After the upload, the transcription and the download options will be displayed below.')
})

```

<div style='padding-bottom:7px;'></div>

```{r}

renderUI({
  if(isTruthy(input$upload)) {
    
    # Create the actual downloadLink
    output$transcript_download_docx_link = renderUI({
      downloadLink('transcript_download_docx', 
                   HTML('<i class="fas fa-file-word fa-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>&nbsp; Download .docx'),
                   style = 'border-bottom:none !important; text-decoration: none !important; font-weight: normal !important;', 
                   class = 'transcript-download')
    })
    
    # Add download handling
    output$transcript_download_docx = downloadHandler(
      
      filename = reactive({
        paste0(input$downloaded_file_name, '.docx') %>%
          # Edit file name to remove repeated extension
          str_replace('\\.docx.docx$', '.docx')
      }),
      
      # Based on: https://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/generating-reports.html
      content = function(file) {
        # Render a copy of the renderer and the Word template in a new temporary
        # directory, as the app directory may not be writable once deployed, and
        # a separate directory for each download keeps simultaneous users apart
        render_dir = tempfile('docx-')
        dir.create(render_dir)
        on.exit(unlink(render_dir, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
        file.copy(c('assets/VTT-Transcription-App_doc_renderer.Rmd',
                    'assets/VTT-Transcription-App-format-template.docx'),
                  render_dir)
        rmarkdown::render(file.path(render_dir, 'VTT-Transcription-App_doc_renderer.Rmd'),
                          output_file = file, quiet = TRUE)
      }
    )
    
    # Show link
    uiOutput('transcript_download_docx_link')
    
  }
})

```

<div style='padding-bottom:7px;'></div>

```{r}

renderUI({
  if(isTruthy(input$upload)) {
    
    # Create the actual downloadLink
    output$transcript_download_txt_link = renderUI({
      downloadLink('transcript_download_txt', 
                   HTML('<i class="fas fa-file-alt fa-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>&nbsp; Download .txt'),
                   style = 'border-bottom:none !important; text-decoration: none !important; font-weight: normal !important;', 
                   class = 'transcript-download')
    })
    
    # Add download handling
    output$transcript_download_txt = downloadHandler(
      filename = reactive({
        paste0(input$downloaded_file_name, '.txt') %>%
          # Edit file name to remove repeated extension
          str_replace('\\.txt.txt$', '.txt')
      }),
      content = function(file) { cat(transcript(), file = file) }
    )
    
    # Show link
    uiOutput('transcript_download_txt_link')
    
  }
})

```
